dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: An ndéarfá go bhfuil obair bhaile níos furasta ná obair ag oifig?
dialogue.translation: Would you say that working from home is easier than working in an office?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Is furasta é i gcúinsí ach is féidir go mbeadh sé níos daingean ar do shláinte mheabhrach.
dialogue.translation: It’s easier in some ways, but it can be harder on your mental health.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Tá a lán tairbhe le obair bhaile, mar shampla, níl orm a bheith ag taisteal.
dialogue.translation: There are a lot of benefits to working from home, for example, I don’t have to travel.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sea, ach is féidir go mbeadh tú níos aonair ar deireadh.
dialogue.translation: Yes, but you can end up feeling more isolated.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ní chomh mór an difríocht sin más agat cáinéis le do chomh-obairthe.
dialogue.translation: That difference isn’t as big if you have regular contact with your colleagues.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ar ndóigh, ach is é an príomh-chúis go bhfuil muintir ag obair bhaile níos sásta go ginearálta.
dialogue.translation: Of course, but the main reason is that people working from home are generally happier.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ní hamháin sin ach tá níos mó saoirse le do chuid ama.
dialogue.translation: Not only that, but you have more freedom with your time.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Go deimhin, tá sé sin fíor, ach ní furasta é a rialú go háirithe más tú le teaghlach.
dialogue.translation: Definitely, that’s true, but it’s not easy to manage, especially if you have a family.
